description: This file contains validation functions for DNS labels and subdomains according to RFC 1123, including regex patterns, error messages, and validation logic.

methods.name: IsDNS1123Label
methods.description: Validates if a string conforms to DNS RFC 1123 label rules.

methods.name: IsDNS1123Subdomain
methods.description: Validates if a string conforms to DNS RFC 1123 subdomain rules in lowercase.

methods.name: IsDNS1123SubdomainCaseless
methods.description: Validates if a string conforms to DNS RFC 1123 subdomain rules, allowing uppercase (deprecated).
